يتعاطون (form VI)
# يَتَعَاطَوْنَ (yataʕāṭawna) /ja.ta.ʕaː.tˤaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# يُتَعَاطَوْنَ (yutaʕāṭawna) /ju.ta.ʕaː.tˤaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
